scripts.dev: pnpm db:local && concurrently -k -n web,api "pnpm --filter @xstream/web dev" "pnpm dev:worker"
scripts.db:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config apps/worker/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p apps/web && tsc -p apps/worker && tsc -p functions && tsc -p tests
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @xstream/web build && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config apps/worker/wrangler.jsonc --outdir dist && wrangler pages functions build functions --outfile=.wrangler/pages/index.js
scripts.deploy:pages: wrangler pages deploy apps/web/dist --project-name xstream --branch main
scripts.db:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.production.jsonc
scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy

APP_ORIGIN.description: Exact HTTPS origin of this Worker (for example, https://your-worker.your-subdomain.workers.dev). Update the copied wrangler.jsonc and redeploy if the URL is not known yet.

TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: A unique base64-encoded 32-byte random key. Generate with node -e "console.log(require('node:crypto').randomBytes(32).toString('base64'))". Keep this value stable.

DB.description: D1 database used to store encrypted sign-in sessions.
